SELECT id roleId,code roleCode,name roleName,description roleDesc,enabled FROM app_role ORDER BY code
SELECT id permissionId,code permissionCode,name permissionName,permission_group permissionGroup,description permissionDesc FROM app_permission ORDER BY code

SELECT r.code roleCode,r.name roleName,r.enabled,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.code ORDER BY p.code SEPARATOR ',') permissionCodes FROM app_role r LEFT JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id LEFT JOIN app_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id GROUP BY r.id,r.code,r.name,r.enabled ORDER BY r.code

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_role(user_id,role_id) SELECT #{id},id FROM app_role WHERE code=#{code} AND enabled=TRUE
mapper.delete: DELETE ur FROM user_role ur JOIN app_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{id} AND r.code IN ('PROJECT_LEADER','EXPERT','FINANCE_ADMIN')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role_permission(role_id,permission_id) SELECT #{id},id FROM app_permission WHERE code=#{code}
